regret_definition: Selected median paired normalized latency minus the minimum over eager and all 25 candidates. Each candidate cost is the median of three same-process candidate/eager latency ratios. Zero is the measured finite-table oracle.

bootstrap.aggregation: Average replay episodes and, for PPO, all five fixed training seeds within each workload; resample six shape families with all three dtypes together.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on this measured table, recorded trajectories and fixed checkpoints. Replays are reused measurements, not new GPU samples. Six clusters give exploratory descriptive intervals, not a population policy/GPU ranking or an interval over new training seeds.

panels.label: 20 replay episodes per workload
panels.ppo_aggregation: Equal mean over all five frozen training seeds; no best-seed selection

panels.label: First replay episode per workload
panels.ppo_aggregation: Equal mean over all five frozen training seeds; no best-seed selection

compile_baseline.incumbent_rule: Retain eager unless a queried measurement improves the incumbent

transfer.scope: Frozen source choices evaluated on the RTX 4090 table; equal workload weights. PPO was not in this earlier transfer experiment.

compiled.interval_source: Published paired-latency family bootstrap; monotone transform, not a new experiment

native.interval_source: Published paired-latency family bootstrap; monotone transform, not a new experiment

native_with_fallback.interval_source: Published paired-latency family bootstrap; monotone transform, not a new experiment

live_limit: Separate RTX 4090 allocation; one prospectively selected PPO seed; native 24 configurations plus three fallback probes versus eight PPO queries. No fresh live oracle or equal-search-budget regret comparison.
